Slack — #ops-alerts.setupNote: Create a Slack OAuth2 credential named '[Recruitment] Slack Bot' in n8n, then attach to this node. See SETUP.md for required Slack scopes.

_meta.activationNote: After attaching the Slack credential, activate this workflow FIRST before activating any other Recruitment workflow. Then set this workflow ID as the Error Workflow in each of the 6 other workflows' Settings.
